    // The centre of the top disk, at +Height/2 along Axis.
    TopCenter(f: ConicalFrustum): Point3D
        => f.Center + f.Axis.Vector * (f.Height * 0.5);

    // The slant height sqrt((r1 - r2)^2 + h^2).
    SlantHeight(f: ConicalFrustum): Number
        => ((f.BottomRadius - f.TopRadius).Square + f.Height.Square).Sqrt;

    // (pi * h / 3) * (r1^2 + r1*r2 + r2^2).
    // https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Frustum#Volume
    Volume(f: ConicalFrustum): Number
        => Number.Pi * f.Height
        * (f.BottomRadius.Square + f.BottomRadius * f.TopRadius + f.TopRadius.Square) / 3.0;

    // The lateral surface pi*(r1 + r2)*l PLUS both disks pi*(r1^2 + r2^2).
    SurfaceArea(f: ConicalFrustum): Number
        => Number.Pi * (f.BottomRadius.Square + f.TopRadius.Square)
        + Number.Pi * (f.BottomRadius + f.TopRadius) * f.SlantHeight;

    // On the axis, at (h/4) * (r1^2 + 2*r1*r2 + 3*r2^2) / (r1^2 + r1*r2 + r2^2)
    // above the BOTTOM disk — restated here relative to Center, which sits at h/2.
    // Checks out at both ends: r2 = 0 gives h/4 (the cone) and r1 = r2 gives h/2
    // (the cylinder). https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Frustum
    Centroid(f: ConicalFrustum): Point3D
    {
        var r1 = f.BottomRadius;
        var r2 = f.TopRadius;
        var fromBottom = f.Height * 0.25
            * (r1.Square + 2.0 * r1 * r2 + 3.0 * r2.Square)
            / (r1.Square + r1 * r2 + r2.Square);
        return f.BottomCenter + f.Axis.Vector * fromBottom;
    }

    // TIGHT: the union of the two disks' own bounds.
    Bounds(f: ConicalFrustum): Bounds3D
        => UnionOfBounds(DiskBounds(f.BottomCenter, f.Axis.Vector, f.BottomRadius),
            DiskBounds(f.TopCenter, f.Axis.Vector, f.TopRadius));

    // True when the query lies between the two disks AND within the frustum's
    // radius at that height, which interpolates linearly from r1 to r2.
    Contains(f: ConicalFrustum, point: Point3D): Boolean
    {
        var v = f.Center.Between(point);
        var t = v.Dot(f.Axis.Vector);
        var fraction = (t + f.Height * 0.5) / f.Height;
        return t.Abs <= f.Height * 0.5
            && PerpendicularComponent(v, f.Axis.Vector).Magnitude
                <= f.BottomRadius + (f.TopRadius - f.BottomRadius) * fraction;
    }

    //==
    // # Disk, triangle, and quadrilateral bodies
    //
    // Area, perimeter, bounds, centroid and nearest-point bodies for the flat patches
    // declared in `spatial-primitives.types.plato`, plus the triangle's vector area, face normal,
    // and supporting plane. These are patches, not solids: `Area` is the patch's own area
    // and `ClosestPoint` always lands ON the patch. The frame and disk-extent helpers are
    // in the shared section above, and the point-list kernels in
    // `geometry.library.plato`.

    //==
    // # Disk3D
    //
    // A flat patch, not a solid: `Area` is the patch's area and `Perimeter` its rim.

    // pi * r^2.
    Area(d: Disk3D): Number
        => Number.Pi * d.Radius.Square;

    // The rim's circumference 2 * pi * r.
    Perimeter(d: Disk3D): Number
        => 2.0 * Number.Pi * d.Radius;


    // TIGHT: the disk's own per-axis extents.
    Bounds(d: Disk3D): Bounds3D
        => DiskBounds(d.Center, d.Normal.Vector, d.Radius);

    // The query projected onto the disk's plane, then pulled radially back to the
    // rim if it landed outside. Always lands ON the patch.
    ClosestPoint(d: Disk3D, point: Point3D): Point3D
    {
        var inPlane = PerpendicularComponent(d.Center.Between(point), d.Normal.Vector);
        var distance = inPlane.Magnitude;
        return d.Center + (distance <= d.Radius
            ? inPlane
            : inPlane * (d.Radius / distance));
    }

    //==
    // # Triangle3D

    // The three vertices in stored order.
    Points(t: Triangle3D): Array<Point3D>
        => [t.A, t.B, t.C];

    // Twice the vector area: the cross product of two edge vectors, whose direction
    // is the right-hand-rule normal and whose magnitude is twice the area.
    TwiceVectorArea(t: Triangle3D): Vector3D
        => t.A.Between(t.B).Cross(t.A.Between(t.C));

    // Half the magnitude of the edge cross product.
    // https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Triangle#Using_vectors
    Area(t: Triangle3D): Number
        => t.TwiceVectorArea.Magnitude * 0.5;

    // The unit face normal, following the right-hand rule around A, B, C (this
    // type's stated orientation). Undefined for a degenerate (collinear) triangle,
    // whose vector area is zero.
    Normal(t: Triangle3D): Direction3D
        => Direction3D(t.TwiceVectorArea.Normalize);

    // The plane the triangle lies in, in Hesse form: the face normal with Distance
    // the signed distance from the world origin (Dot(Normal, A)). The declared
    // conversion clipping and BSP authors reach for.
    FromTriangle(t: Triangle3D): Plane
        => (t.Normal, t.A.PositionVector.Dot(t.Normal.Vector));

    // The sum of the three side lengths.
    Perimeter(t: Triangle3D): Number
        => t.A.Between(t.B).Magnitude
        + t.B.Between(t.C).Magnitude
        + t.C.Between(t.A).Magnitude;

    // The arithmetic mean of the three vertices, which for a triangle is also its
    // area centroid.
    Centroid(t: Triangle3D): Point3D
        => ((t.A.X + t.B.X + t.C.X) / 3.0,
            (t.A.Y + t.B.Y + t.C.Y) / 3.0,
            (t.A.Z + t.B.Z + t.C.Z) / 3.0);

    // True when `point`, ASSUMED ALREADY IN THE TRIANGLE'S PLANE, lies inside it:
    // all three edge cross products agree with the triangle's own normal.
    ContainsCoplanar(t: Triangle3D, point: Point3D): Boolean
    {
        var n = t.TwiceVectorArea;
        return t.A.Between(t.B).Cross(t.A.Between(point)).Dot(n) >= 0.0
            && t.B.Between(t.C).Cross(t.B.Between(point)).Dot(n) >= 0.0
            && t.C.Between(t.A).Cross(t.C.Between(point)).Dot(n) >= 0.0;
    }

    // The query projected onto the triangle's plane when that projection lands
    // inside, otherwise the nearest point of the three edges. A degenerate
    // (collinear) triangle has no plane, so the edge branch takes over — its
    // projection test fails on the zero normal.
    ClosestPoint(t: Triangle3D, point: Point3D): Point3D
    {
        var n = t.TwiceVectorArea.Normalize;
        var projected = point - n * t.A.Between(point).Dot(n);
        return t.ContainsCoplanar(projected)
            ? projected
            : t.Points.ClosestPointOnChain(true, point);
    }

    // The triangle with all three vertices carried through the mapping.
    Deform(t: Triangle3D, mapping: Function1<Point3D, Point3D>): Triangle3D
        => (mapping(t.A), mapping(t.B), mapping(t.C));
